blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Philippines is working with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) Philippines to come up with a strategic and coordinated national response to climate-related loss and damage. Coordinating the efforts with the UNDP are the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) and the Climate Change Commission (CCC). In a DENR statement issued on Saturday, Environment Secretary Juan Miguel T. Cuna said: “Building on its role as host of the Board of the Fund for responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD), the country is working to translate international momentum into concrete actions that help communities address the compounding and […]...
